from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class MPU6050_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 16

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            # Initialize all registers to their reset values
            0x19: 0x00,  # SMPLRT_DIV
            0x1A: 0x00,  # CONFIG
            0x1B: 0x00,  # GYRO_CONFIG
            0x1C: 0x00,  # ACCEL_CONFIG
            0x3B: 0x00,  # ACCEL_XOUT_H
            0x3C: 0x00,  # ACCEL_XOUT_L
            0x3D: 0x00,  # ACCEL_YOUT_H
            0x3E: 0x00,  # ACCEL_YOUT_L
            0x3F: 0x00,  # ACCEL_ZOUT_H
            0x40: 0x00,  # ACCEL_ZOUT_L
            0x6B: 0x40,  # PWR_MGMT_1
            0x75: 0x68   # WHO_AM_I
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Single byte semantics: return only bits 15:8
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8
        else:
            # Default: return the whole 16-bit register
            return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Single byte semantics: update only bits 15:8
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | ((data & 0xFF) << 8)
        else:
            # Default: write the whole 16-bit data
            self.regs[addr] = data
